assay_run.method: Spontaneous CAG-driven GCaMP6f calcium imaging of 3-month R306C and isogenic-control organoids at 1300 nm in a microfluidic holder. Figure 2c–d and 2e–f use the same reported functional acquisition settings (100 µm depth, 5 Hz, 256×256) with different dataset summaries. Individual recordings, panel overlap and specimen-to-file mapping are unresolved. Figure 2b provides separate structural GCaMP/THG context.
assay_run.platform: Custom-built three-photon microscope; Spectra-Physics Spirit-NOPA laser system

condition.time: At the 3-month (D90) imaging stage after differentiation initiation
At the 3-month (D90) imaging stage after differentiation initiation
